_comment: Tier-0 starter for the Penitent path. A lead-headed mace -- the metal that crushes the hypocrites in their gilded cloaks (Inferno XXIII). Per [[project_class_stats_v2_locked_2026_06_14]] descent-stair starter doctrine: scales for the class without being class-named. Hell-substrate Hell-craft, left by a prior Vagrant who carried it down. Lead is the cosmologically perfect material for the Penitent: the punishment IS weight (Canto XXIII), the path is weight and struggle. The mace's head pulls the wielder forward into the swing -- endurance carries the verb. Scales primarily on END (Penitent's high-soft-cap stat) with STR contributing to the raw crush. Identity contribution from Penance in a Penitent's hands. Mundane name -- just a lead mace.
name: Lead mace
description: A lead head set on an iron haft. The weight pulls forward of its own will -- the swing wants only to be allowed.
